reports.title: Blue River PFHA fishing report
reports.text: Largemouth Bass, Smallmouth Bass, Spotted Bass Good on crankbaits, lipless baits, plastic baits, topwater lures, tube jigs around brush structure, channels, creek channels, river channel, rocks, shallows, shorelines, weed beds.

reports.title: Kaw Lake fishing report
reports.text: Largemouth Bass, Spotted Bass Slow on crankbaits, jerk baits, spinnerbaits, topwater lures around docks, points, riprap, shorelines.

reports.title: Grand Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Largemouth Bass Fair on crankbaits, plastic baits, spinnerbaits around brush structure, docks, shorelines.
White Crappie Fair on jigs, minnows around brush structure, docks.

reports.title: Konawa fishing report
reports.text: Largemouth Bass Good on crankbaits, plastic baits, spinnerbaits around main lake, points, river channel, weed beds.

reports.title: Texoma fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie, White Crappie Fair on hair jigs, jigs, minnows around brush structure, coves, docks.
Crappie are good with black and yellow jigs with a glow in the dark power bait Nibblett around brush, piles and docks.

reports.title: Keystone Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie, White Crappie Good on jigs, minnows around brush structure, docks, main lake.
Largemouth Bass Good on in-line spinnerbaits, jerk baits, jigs, plastic baits, small lures, spinnerbaits around brush structure, rocks.

reports.title: McGee Creek fishing report
reports.text:
Largemouth Bass, Spotted Bass Good on Alabama rig, bill baits, in-line spinnerbaits, jerk baits, jigs, plastic baits, other around brush structure, points, standing timber, other.
Black Crappie, White Crappie Fair on jigs, minnows around brush structure, standing timber.

reports.title: Broken Bow Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Largemouth Bass, Spotted Bass Good on Alabama rig, crawfish, spinnerbaits, worms around coves, points.
Black Crappie, White Crappie Good on jigs around brush structure, channels, standing timber.

reports.title: Pine Creek Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Largemouth Bass Slow on crankbaits, plastic baits around coves, points.
White Crappie Slow on jigs, minnows around brush structure, main lake, standing timber.

reports.title: Sardis Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Largemouth Bass Good on bill baits, crankbaits, lipless baits, plastic baits, spinnerbaits around brush structure, channels, points, shorelines, standing timber.
Black Crappie, White Crappie Good on jigs, minnows, tube jigs around brush structure, standing timber.
